name: MAKO
description: Trust layer for agent commerce on Base. Four callable pillars — pre-spend Verifier ($0.25), per-endpoint Pulse reliability ($0.02), per-category Pricing Index ($0.02), and per-wallet Reputation Score ($0.03, ERC-8004 compatible) — plus DAO Governance Ops endpoints. Every paid Verifier call writes a verification record that feeds the other three pillars. Live Pulse scoreboard at /pulse currently scoring 142+ services across the agentic.market directory. Operated by Pollinate Research.
